title: The Coordination Tax and the Heterogeneity Dividend: Break-Even Conditions for Multi-Agent LLM Pipelines
abstract: arXiv:2610.37700v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent LLM pipelines built on interoperability protocols such as the Open Floor Protocol (OFP) or A2A are usually justified on capability grounds, with their runtime cost treated as an overhead of unknown size. Comparing such a pipeline with one model call is underspecified, because a pipeline can give each role a different model. We give a closed-form model that sets the coordination tax (decomposition overhead plus per-handoff protocol cost) against the heterogeneity dividend from routing work to a cheaper model, with a break-even threshold and a feasibility bound, $\alpha < 1/r$, and measure every term, with OFP as the protocol under test, on 135 HumanEval and ClassEval tasks in 2430 runs of six architectures with Claude Opus 5.5 and Haiku 5.5. The protocol adds 7.2 ms per handoff, 0.11% of pipeline wall time. Decomposition does not pay on these tasks: a planner-coder-reviewer pipeline costs 3.22x as much as a single strong cal

translated_title: 协调税与异质性红利：多智能体LLM流水线的盈亏平衡条件
translated_abstract: 基于互操作性协议（如Open Floor协议（OFP）或A2A）构建的多智能体LLM流水线，通常从能力角度进行论证，其运行时成本被视为大小未知的开销。将此类流水线与单次模型调用进行比较是不够明确的，因为流水线可以为每个角色分配不同的模型。我们给出了一个闭式模型，将协调税（分解开销加上每次交接的协议成本）与将工作路由到更便宜模型所产生的异质性红利进行对比，得到了盈亏平衡阈值和可行性边界 $\alpha < 1/r$，并以OFP作为受测协议，在135个HumanEval和ClassEval任务上进行了2430次运行，涵盖六种架构，使用Claude Opus 5.5和Haiku 5.5，对每一项进行了测量。协议每次交接增加7.2毫秒，仅占流水线总运行时间的0.11%。在这些任务上，分解并不划算：规划者-编码者-审查者流水线的成本是单次强模型调用的3.22倍。
tldr: 本文提出一个闭式模型来量化多智能体LLM流水线中协调税与异质性红利的盈亏平衡条件（α < 1/r），并通过大规模实验发现协议开销可忽略不计（每次交接仅7.2毫秒），但在编程任务上多智能体分解并不划算。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a closed-form model quantifying the break-even condition (α < 1/r) between the coordination tax and heterogeneity dividend in multi-agent LLM pipelines, showing empirically that protocol overhead is negligible (7.2 ms per handoff) while decomposition does not pay off on coding tasks.
